narr: Afternoon heating brought scattered showers and thunderstorms. Plentiful moisture in these storms resulted in localized flash flooding.
ev: The streets near the intersection of Walnut Street and 2nd Street were flooded curb to curb and water was flowing across the roadway.
lsr: THE STREETS NEAR THE INTERSECTION OF WALNUT STREET AND SECOND STREET WERE FLOODED CURB TO CURB, AND WATER WAS FLOWING ACROSS THE ROADWAY. REPORT AND PICTURES RELAYED VIA TWITTER.
